confirmed_invariants: A single relevant failure alert appears next to current retry actions.
Failure preserves selected options, saved pointer, old round/result and local score history.
Hidden reserved error text has no alert role and is excluded from accessibility.
No new API/session fields, scores, request bounds or server TTL/cap changes.
No forced scrolling, overlay or new retry route.
Saved-resume recovery remains a separate flow.
remaining_gate: The full native/browser/backend release matrix belongs to the root integration receipts.

native_guard_expectation_update.reason: Four historical source-shape assertions were stale after the stronger creating/flight guards. The updated checks preserve all old empty/depleted/recovery behaviors and require the new guards; the CaldRece check uses a bounded function slice instead of a wider character window.

archive_note: Raw log bytes are preserved losslessly in gzip. log_sha256 binds decompressed original bytes; archive_sha256 binds the committed archive. This avoids treating tool-emitted trailing spaces as authored source whitespace.
